name: Savannah
tagline: Moss-Draped Squares, Affordable Southern Charm, and Coastal Access
description: Savannah offers one of the best value propositions among charming Southern cities. Its iconic moss-draped squares, historic architecture, and walkable downtown create a storybook setting at a fraction of the cost of nearby Charleston. Georgia's moderate tax burden and Savannah's genuinely affordable housing make it an excellent FIRE destination. The city's art scene, excellent seafood, and proximity to Tybee Island beaches round out a compelling retirement package.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe in historic and suburban areas; some rougher pockets
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot, humid summers and mild, short winters

housing.description: Studio/small 1BR in Thunderbolt, quieter Midtown, or the Starland District (city 1BR avg ~$1,427; cheap 1BR ~$1,309)

dining.description: Casual Southern fare a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan on Georgia's ACA marketplace, with the premium capped by income as long as annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600 for a single person; above that it goes to full price. Priced for an early retiree aged 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: Paid-off used car + GA full coverage (~$180–250, gentler than FL) + gas

entertainment.description: Free walks through the 22 squares, Forsyth Park, Tybee day trips

1M.lifestyle: A frugal studio or small one-bedroom in Thunderbolt, quieter Midtown, or the Starland District anchors an affordable, walkable-ish life in one of the South's most charming small cities. A subsidized ACA plan, held down by managing income under the returned 400%-FPL cliff, and a paid-off car — Georgia's insurance runs gentler than Florida's, easing the transport line — are the recurring floors, with most meals cooked at home and casual Southern spots a few times a week. The 22 moss-draped squares, Forsyth Park, and a short drive to Tybee Island beach cost nothing. Summer air-conditioning is the bill to watch, but Savannah's cheaper housing makes this an unusually comfortable lean budget.

housing.description: Nicer 1BR on the Starland or Ardsley Park edge

dining.description: Dining out 3-4x/week at River Street restaurants and local favorites

healthcare.description: Full-price (unsubsidized) low-cost Silver/Bronze, ~48yo — income above the returned ACA cliff

transportation.description: Reliable mid-range car, insurance, gas for beach and day trip outings

entertainment.description: SCAD events, River Street live music

2M.lifestyle: A nicer one-bedroom on the Starland or Ardsley Park edge buys a lively, walkable pocket near the city's arts scene. Income has crossed the ACA subsidy cliff, so healthcare becomes a full-price plan, and a reliable car handles beach and day trips. Dining out a few times a week along River Street and at local favorites, SCAD events, and live music fill the calendar, with solid health coverage rounding things out. Savannah's affordability makes this a genuinely comfortable level in a beautiful setting.

housing.description: Quality 1BR in the Historic District, Victorian District, or Ardsley Park

dining.description: The Grey, Elizabeth on 37th, the Olde Pink House

healthcare.description: Unsubsidized Chatham-rating-area Silver at full price (above the cliff); Georgia benchmark premiums run close to Florida's, not below them (cheapest Silver ~$956 @50)

3M.lifestyle: A quality one-bedroom in the Historic District, the Victorian District, or Ardsley Park puts daily life among the squares and live oaks, walkable to River Street and the waterfront. Dining out is frequent at The Grey, Elizabeth on 37th, and the Olde Pink House, and healthcare is a full-price, unsubsidized plan — Georgia's ACA premiums run competitive with Florida's, so this line is no bargain once income clears the subsidy cliff. A reliable car handles the region, with boating on the Intracoastal and Tybee day trips built in. SCAD arts events, live music, and a golf membership fit comfortably. Savannah's low housing base leaves substantial travel-and-savings margin at this level.

housing.description: Grand residence on a Historic square or an Ardsley Park home

healthcare.description: Rich unsubsidized Gold/PPO plus a direct-primary-care / concierge retainer

5M.lifestyle: A grand residence on a Historic square or an Ardsley Park home, with a weekly housekeeper, marks an upper-affluent Savannah life. Fine dining is frequent at The Grey and the city's best tables, healthcare adds a concierge or direct-primary-care retainer to a full-price plan, and a luxury car with a boat for the Intracoastal covers the outings. Private-club memberships, Film Festival patronage, and business-class travel are all within budget. Savannah's lower costs compared with Charleston or the Florida coast mean this level of spending covers a well-appointed, well-traveled life with plenty of margin.

housing.description: Grand historic home on a square, or a Wilmington/Tybee Island waterfront estate

healthcare.description: Top-tier unsubsidized PPO plus a concierge retainer (US-market basis)

entertainment.description: Preservation galas, SCAD patronage, private clubs

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper, grounds service, and part-time help

luxuryExtras.description: Preservation endowments, first-class travel, club dues

10M.lifestyle: A grand historic home on one of the squares, or a waterfront estate on Wilmington or Tybee Island, kept by household staff, anchors life at the top of Savannah — and because the city's cost base is so low, this uncapped-luxury life lands near the most affordable US metros rather than the coastal ones. Dining is near-daily across the city's finest tables, healthcare pairs a top-tier plan with a concierge retainer, and a luxury vehicle and a private boat cover the historic core and the waterways. Preservation philanthropy, SCAD arts patronage, private-club memberships, and first-class travel are all comfortable, with generous discretionary margin besides. The storybook setting delivers a feeling of grandeur well beyond the price.
